games.name: [BANS] Make an Error
games.desc:
😵 Welcome to Make an Error! (formerly Untitled Error Creator)

Type anything, style it your way, fool your friends, or just be funny!

⚙️ HOW TO MAKE AN ERROR:
• Click the Create Error button at the bottom
• Fill in your title, message, code, and buttons
• Hit the blue Play button to see it in action!

🎨 HOW TO SWITCH ERROR STYLES:
• Press Create Error
• At the bottom right, click the Styles button
• Choose your favorite look, like our brand new Ban style!
• Swap styles anytime to test them all out!

✨ FEATURES:
• 🔠 Custom titles
• 💬 Editable messages
• ⚠️ Fake error codes
• ☑️ Button text editing
• 👥 Share with other players
• 💾 Save and load your errors anytime

🎉 Updates, events & more in the group! JOIN HERE:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/35492849/Little-Plane#!/about

👍 LIKE + FAVORITE if you enjoy the game!
